skill.name: openclawemailskill
skill.description: Plan, review, audit, and migrate email campaign operations with provider-neutral playbooks, explicit approval gates, and clear audit trails for agent handoffs.
skill.summary: Creates auditable email campaign playbooks, migration checks, QA packets, and approval-gated runbooks.
skill.author: Sequenzy

security_audit.summary: The static system reconnaissance alert is a false positive. The cited line is only a section heading, and the skill text requires explicit approval before live email, DNS, imports, or suppression changes.

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 19 is only the heading 'Avoid Using It For' and does not request host, network, or account reconnaissance. Nearby instructions restrict risky email operations behind explicit approval.

content.value_statement: Email campaign work can hide risky provider actions and unclear assumptions. This skill turns audits, migrations, and execution plans into inspectable playbooks with approval gates.
actual_capabilities: Classifies email work as inspect, plan, draft, migrate, QA, or execute-with-approval.
Inventories safe artifacts such as exports, templates, CSV samples, logs, and campaign briefs.
Translates provider-specific terms into portable campaign concepts.
Builds reversible playbook steps before commands, API calls, or platform actions.
Separates evidence from recommendations for clear agent and reviewer handoffs.
Adds approval gates for live sends, imports, DNS edits, suppression changes, and production automation edits.
limitations: Does not send emails or change production systems by itself.
Requires user-provided artifacts such as exports, templates, logs, or campaign briefs.
Cannot verify live provider state without current user-provided evidence.
Does not replace legal, deliverability, or privacy compliance review.

use_cases.title: Audit a Campaign Handoff
use_cases.description: Review exports, templates, and briefs, then produce evidence-based notes and approval gates.

use_cases.title: Plan a Provider Migration
use_cases.description: Compare source and target capabilities before moving fields, segments, automations, or suppression data.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Agent Runbook
use_cases.description: Create a reversible execution plan that another agent can inspect without hidden context.

prompt_templates.title: Review Basic Email Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review these email campaign artifacts. List evidence, assumptions, risks, and questions before recommending any action.

prompt_templates.title: Build a QA Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a QA checklist for this campaign. Include provider-specific checks, portable interpretations, and approval gates.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Provider Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to compare these source and target email provider artifacts. Identify parity gaps, migration risks, rollback notes, and review steps.

prompt_templates.title: Draft an Execution Runbook
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to draft an approval-gated runbook for this email operation. Separate inspection, reversible preparation, approval, execution, and rollback.

output_examples.input: A team provides campaign exports and asks whether a launch is ready.
output_examples.output: The skill returns an evidence summary, unresolved assumptions, QA checks, launch blockers, and approval steps for live sending.

output_examples.input: A marketer wants to move segments and automations to another email provider.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a provider comparison, field mapping concerns, suppression handling notes, migration checkpoints, and rollback guidance.

output_examples.input: An agent needs a handoff packet for a production email change.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a runbook with inspection steps, prepared changes, explicit approval points, and post-change verification tasks.

best_practices: Provide current exports, templates, logs, screenshots, and campaign briefs for review.
Keep live sends, imports, DNS edits, and suppression changes behind explicit human approval.
Ask for evidence, recommendations, rollback notes, and approvals as separate sections.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the agent to infer permissions from convenience or urgency.
Do not request live provider changes without a named approval owner.
Do not use the skill for generic email advice without artifacts or context.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps plan, audit, migrate, QA, and document email campaign operations with clear evidence and approval gates.

faq.question: Can it send emails?
faq.answer: No. It can prepare runbooks and checks, but live sends require explicit human approval outside the skill.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What inputs work best?
faq.answer: Useful inputs include ESP exports, templates, CSV samples, logs, screenshots, campaign briefs, and migration goals.

faq.question: Does it support provider migrations?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares provider capabilities and highlights field, segment, automation, and suppression risks.

faq.question: How does it reduce operational risk?
faq.answer: It separates evidence from recommendations, adds rollback notes, and requires approval before high-risk actions.
